label: TWELVE-YEAR GAP
data: Penicillin's 12-year gap — Sept 1928 discovery & June 1929 paper → May 1940 Oxford test (8 infected mice: 4 treated survived, 4 untreated died) → 1941 clinical proof
scale: twelve years sitting in a neglected medical journal before four surviving mice proved penicillin worked inside a living body
